# hangar: marcadores de estado + bilhete pane->sessao (app/kimi_hook_installer).
# Remova este bloco para desligar o rastreio de sessoes Kimi pelo app.
[[hooks]]
event = "SessionStart"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/kimi_state_hook.py"'
timeout = 5

[[hooks]]
event = "UserPromptSubmit"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/kimi_state_hook.py"'
timeout = 5

[[hooks]]
event = "TurnStarted"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/kimi_state_hook.py"'
timeout = 5

[[hooks]]
event = "Stop"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/kimi_state_hook.py"'
timeout = 5

[[hooks]]
event = "Interrupt"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/kimi_state_hook.py"'
timeout = 5

[[hooks]]
event = "PermissionRequest"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/kimi_state_hook.py"'
timeout = 5

[[hooks]]
event = "PreToolUse"
matcher = "AskUserQuestion"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/kimi_state_hook.py"'
timeout = 5

[[hooks]]
event = "PostToolUse"
matcher = "AskUserQuestion"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/kimi_state_hook.py"'
timeout = 5


# hangar: trava de `tmux kill-server` (app/kimi_hook_installer + hooks/guard_tmux.py).
# Remova este bloco para desligar o rastreio de sessoes Kimi pelo app.
[[hooks]]
event = "PreToolUse"
matcher = "Bash"
command = '"$ROOT/repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/repo/backend/hooks/guard_tmux.py"'
timeout = 5
